summary: Hammerhorn Mountain ground cabin in Mendocino NF; news reports date it to late 1921 (register Built field says 1924). Gone, removal unknown; few remnants on summit.

facts.status_note: Removal date unknown; a June 2026 trip report found only a few remnants on the summit
facts.agency: US Forest Service - Mendocino National Forest

access.note: On Mendocino National Forest land and reached on foot; no closure or permit requirement found in the sources read

visit.trail_note: Reached on foot; a June 2026 trip report describes a little old trail and a short scramble, about 10 feet with hand and foot holds, up the summit block.

events.note: Late 1921 per news reports, likely opened for the 1922 season; the register's Built field gives 1924 instead
C.M. Bucknell left in July 1930 to pass the summer at the lookout station
Construction of a 1,200-gallon water tank at the lookout, reported December 3, 1930
Forest Service summer appointments announced April 15, 1932 list C.M. Bucknell at Hammerhorn lookout
Mrs. Williams was at the lookout in September 1946 when a patrol flight dropped mail nearby
A 1948 photo shows the lookout in rough condition; removal date is unknown
Registered April 24, 2020 as FFLOS US 2048, CA 154; nominated by Brad Eells

corrections.proposed: late 1921 (news reports, per the FFLOS description); 1924 kept only as a conflicting register value
corrections.why: The same FFLOS page says construction was in late 1921 according to news reports, and a November 1921 newspaper item describes the lookout house being erected

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The FFLOS Built field says 1924, but its own description and a November 1921 newspaper item place construction in late 1921. The story gives the 1921 date and says the sources disagree.

notes_for_editor: FFLOS Built field (1924) conflicts with its own description (late 1921) and a 1921 newspaper item; correction proposed. Removal date unknown. Access 'public' is inferred from national forest land and the 2026 hiking report, not a stated policy. No photos added; the 1948 photo on FFLOS was not located as an image URL.
